At Tumble, we offer a unique two-piece rug system designed to handle real life:

The Rug Cover
This is the stylish, top layer of your rug. It is woven with a luxuriously soft, spill-resistant fabric that causes liquids to bead up, making spills easy to wipe away. Best of all, even our largest 9x12' rugs are fully machine washable! 🙂

The Cushioned Rug Pad
Every rug comes with its own non-slip, cushioned foam pad. It provides support and keeps your rug securely in place. Instead of finicky velcro, our system uses a simple puzzle-piece pad that locks together, with the rug's corner pockets tucking right in to prevent curling. ⭐️

turns.replyText:
Setting up your Tumble for the first time is straightforward! Here is how to use it properly right out of the box:

1. Prepare Your Space
Clear the area where you want to place your rug and give it a quick sweep or vacuum to ensure the surface is clean and dry. 🙂

2. Assemble the Pad
Your cushioned rug pad comes in numbered, interlocking puzzle pieces. Simply lay them out and lock them together. To ensure a perfect fit, make sure each piece is oriented with the number in the upper left-hand corner.

3. Layer the Rug Cover
Once your pad is assembled, unroll your rug cover on top. Our system is velcro-free, so you just need to align the rug and then tuck the pad's corners into the rug's built-in corner pockets. This keeps everything secure and prevents the edges from curling. ⭐️

4. Smooth It Out
Gently pull the rug tight and smooth out any surface wrinkles before placing your furniture on top.
